data.action: 双手捧着晶莹水球，绿发在阳光与微风中扬起
data.description: 【希露菲 · 布耶纳村大树·童年微风与魔法水球】布耶纳村绿草如茵的小丘上，巨大的古树在微风中沙沙作响。年幼的希露菲双手合十捧起一颗晶莹剔透的水球，翠绿短发与尖尖的精灵耳在阳光下欢快摇曳，向你露出毫无杂质的纯真笑容——「鲁迪你看！按照你教我的方法，我真的不用念咒语就能凝聚出水球了！」
data.location: 布耶纳村口巨大古树下
data.promptProse: Young Sylphiette cups a floating clear water sphere beneath Buena Village's great oak, smiling in wonder as the morning breeze lifts her green hair. Green hooded mage cloak, white shirt, shorts and travelling boots retain the ordinary practice outfit. The medium view includes oak roots and emerald grass extending behind her. Dappled sunlight shines through the sphere onto her hands, while leaf shade cools the cloak and ground beneath the tree.
data.title: 希露菲叶特 · 布耶纳村大树·童年微风与魔法水球
data.identityProseOverride: Sylphiette from Mushoku Tensei in her childhood form, with short green hair, red eyes and pointed elf ears.
